title: EV Charger Installation Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: An original ev charger installation workflow that guides a bounded inspection from readiness through findings and release, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete ev charger installation inspection checklist form for the electric vehicle charging site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when an assigned inspector must confirm safe observation boundaries, document domain-specific conditions, route deficiencies, and record a qualified acceptance, restriction, or follow-up decision. The charging deployment coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: EV charger installation inspection identity and authority
sections.guidance: Define the asset, inspection scope, qualified reviewer, and conditions before observations begin.

sections.title: EV charger installation readiness and safe observation boundary
sections.guidance: Confirm identity, operating context, access, and limits before checking condition.

blocks.label: Stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not an energized-work permit or energy-control procedure. Stop when exposed parts, unknown circuits, failed protection, water intrusion, heat, smoke, or impact damage is present. A qualified and authorized person must control isolation, testing, commissioning, and return to service under current site procedures and applicable requirements.

sections.title: EV charger installation inspection points and finding evidence
sections.guidance: Check each point only when observed; use the findings table for condition, evidence, and disposition.

blocks.label: Domain inspection checklist
items: Charger identity, nameplate, connector, and port assignment match the record
Mounting hardware, pedestal, wall, and foundation show no visible movement
Enclosure, cable, connector, holster, and strain relief are intact
Vehicle clearances, bollards, wheel stops, and traffic path are documented
Accessible approach, operating reach, signage, and stall markings are unobstructed
Drainage, ponding, irrigation, snow storage, and trip hazards are documented
Panel, disconnect, circuit label, and protective-device references are captured
Grounding, bonding, and protection results are recorded by the qualified tester
Network, payment, display, emergency contact, and remote reset functions are checked
Representative charging session and connector release results are recorded
Heat, odor, noise, damage, water ingress, and fault indications are absent or escalated
Open defects, access restrictions, and commissioning dependencies have owners

fields.label: Inaccessible areas, sampling limits, representative conditions, trends, and supporting context

sections.title: EV charger installation exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Exposed or damaged energized component, conductor, connector, or enclosure
Arcing, smoke, abnormal heat, burning odor, or repeated protective trip
Water intrusion, standing water, flood exposure, or damaged seals
Vehicle impact, unstable mounting, sharp edge, or falling equipment
Uncontrolled circuit, unknown backfeed, or incomplete energy isolation
Grounding, bonding, or protective-device result outside approved criteria
Pedestrian, accessible-route, traffic, or cord trip exposure
Work beyond the assigned qualified person's authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not an energized-work permit or energy-control procedure. Stop when exposed parts, unknown circuits, failed protection, water intrusion, heat, smoke, or impact damage is present. A qualified and authorized person must control isolation, testing, commissioning, and return to service under current site procedures and applicable requirements.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each inspection exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: EV charger installation decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Electric vehicle charging site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
